Install the desktop agent. The agent runs on each employee's Windows computer, and records work time for WorkPulse. Let's install it.
On the employee's computer, open WorkPulse in the browser, and click the Download agent button in the top bar.
Click Windows. The installer downloads, and a message tells you when it is complete.
Open the installer from the Downloads folder. If Windows shows a SmartScreen warning, click More info, then Run anyway.
No administrator rights are needed. Click Install, and keep Start WorkPulse ticked. From now on, the agent also starts by itself with Windows.
The WorkPulse window opens. Sign in with the work email and the password from the invitation, or choose Use an enrolment code instead.
Next, review the monitoring permissions. Tick the box to accept, then click Accept and sign in.
Click Start work session. The tray icon shows that the agent is running, and activity soon appears in WorkPulse.
At the end of the day, click Stop work session.
Done. Next, set your work schedule in Settings.
